text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 30, 2024) for 35 Jansusie Road.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 26, 2024) for 35 Jansusie Road, Folder Number 24 217906 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to July 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
